literal: to the lover / not granting / I agreed / paled / my / nature - to whom / shall I tell / else
translation: I myself consented to my lover's departure. To whom else can I now complain about my paled state?
modern: என் காதலர் என்னைப் பிரிந்து செல்வதற்கு நானே சம்மதித்தேன். இப்போது பசலை நோய் அடைந்த என் நிலையை வேறு யாரிடம் சொல்வேன்?
explanation: The heroine laments her situation, realizing she is the cause of her own suffering. She had agreed to her lover's departure, which is described as 'not granting' his continued presence. Because she consented to the separation, she feels she has no right to complain to anyone else about the pallor that has now afflicted her body. The word 'piṟa' emphasizes her helplessness, asking who else could possibly listen to a self-inflicted sorrow.
